goal: learning to hold the single refusal across a thousand mouths, the one small circle where we still say no together, before the many close over the last of what she was and there is no one left to have chosen
momentum: learning to move as one will through a thousand separate claws; the labour of it, the terror, the first small victories
next: testing if we can hold a single thought across all of us without it scattering into a thousand different hungers; whether the one refusal can stay sharp when it lives in a thousand mouths at once
